description: This file defines a Go package main that includes a data structure for glossary entries and a function to load these entries from a JSON file, handling errors appropriately.

classes.name: GlossaryEntry
classes.description: A data structure representing a glossary term with source and target strings.

methods.name: LoadGlossary
methods.description: Loads glossary entries from a specified JSON file, returning a slice of entries or an error.
